decision.reason: [ev-4bcafa8a355e] lists at least six separate changes under one heading: the httpPutResponseHopLimit default goes from 2 to 1 on new EC2NodeClasses, ConsolidateAfter becomes required, NodeClassRef fields become required and apiVersion is renamed to group, AMISelectorTerms become required with Alias limits, the Helm topology spread constraint becomes required zonal spread, and the controller.METRICS_PORT default changes back to 8080. These changes affect different subjects, are different kinds of change, and expose different environments, so no single subject, change, applicability or consequence can be written for this item. [ev-bfb089d90d84] also says this is copied from the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure, which is not shown. The cluster needs to be split into one item per change. Some of the changes are stated clearly enough on their own, for example the hop-limit default and the METRICS_PORT default.
